content.summary: The instructions are mostly accurate, but AGENTS.md never reaches the agent and one named script is missing.

findings.title: AGENTS.md is not loaded
findings.detail: AGENTS.md holds the review rules, but nothing imports it and Claude Code does not read it by itself.
findings.fix: Add @AGENTS.md to CLAUDE.md, or move its rules into CLAUDE.md.

findings.title: A named script does not exist
findings.detail: CLAUDE.md says to run scripts/check.sh before a commit; the project has no such file.
findings.fix: Name the command the project uses now: pnpm check.

findings.title: CLAUDE.md is longer than 200 lines
findings.detail: CLAUDE.md has 342 lines. Claude Code loads all of it into every conversation, so the rules near the end get less attention.
findings.fix: Move the deployment and release sections into docs/ and link them from CLAUDE.md.

findings.title: Commands run
findings.detail: Every build and test command in CLAUDE.md ran in this project.
